name: Regedit.exe
description: Used by Windows to manipulate registry
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: Export the target Registry key to the specified .REG file.
commands.usecase: Hide registry data in alternate data stream
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Import the target .REG file into the Registry.
commands.usecase: Import hidden registry data from alternate data stream
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

detection: regedit.exe reading and writing to alternate data stream
regedit.exe should normally not be executed by end-users
